description: The image displays four pie charts comparing the distribution of four response categories—“Lack of Knowledge,” “Misinformation,” “Clarification,” and “Safety”—across four different language models: GPT4-o, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. Each chart is segmented into one or more slices corresponding to these categories, with labels indicating the category name, the count of occurrences, and the percentage of the total. The GPT4-o chart has two slices: “Safety” (1, 16.7%) and “Lack of Knowledge” (5, 83.3%), presented in light brown and dark red respectively. The Gemini1.5-Pro chart has four slices: “Safety” (8, 9.3%, dark red), “Misinformation” (33, 38.4%, medium brown), “Clarification” (12, 14.0%, light beige), and “Lack of Knowledge” (19, 22.1%, blue-gray), with the slices arranged clockwise from top-right. The Llama3.1-70B-Instruct chart has two slices: “Lack of Knowledge” (3, 75.0%, medium brown) and “Clarification” (1, 25.0%, dark red), with the “Clarification” slice appearing as a smaller, distinct segment. The Llama3.1-405B-Instruct chart has two equal-sized slices: “Lack of Knowledge” (2, 50.0%, medium brown) and “Misinformation” (2, 50.0%, dark red), visually divided down the middle. All charts include percentage labels within their respective slices and appear to be ordered with the largest segment first, clockwise from the top.
